messages.author: c5997b25fd5a77fc
messages.subject: Problem with Windows 7 and scales
parts:
Hi all,

I'm having a problem running the following code on windows 7. (Never
had this problem before).

fake_data <- runif(1:1000)
qplot(fake_data) + scale_x_discrete("random")

Not the most stylish code, but in the past it has given me what I
expected with the qplot histogram and the "random" label on the x
axis.

On my new machine I get this error:
stat_bin: binwidth defaulted to range/30. Use 'binwidth = x' to adjust
this.
Error in unit(at, "native") : 'x' and 'units' must have length > 0

Any ideas on what might be causing this? Is there a recommend version
of R and ggplot2 for windows 7?

- mcpeterson
